entries.en: sash or band of the dress; belt for the clothing (cinto ... del vestido)

entries.zh: 韜带（束衣的带子）；〔“Zo/To”音写有疑〕
entries.en: band for wrapping the dress (cinto ... del vestido); the first syllable is uncertain in the manuscript (Zo, doubtful reading To)
entries.notes: source_M 首音节标注 [疑:To]，韜字带子义与西语 cinto 相合，但音写不可确证。

entries.en: waistband; belt worn round the waist (cinto ceñido)

entries.zh: 松柏；柏树（常青树，译作 ciprés）
entries.en: pine and cypress; cypress (evergreen tree, Sp. ciprés)
entries.notes: 汉栏为松栢并举，西语词头仅取柏（ciprés），17 世纪欧洲以 cypress 喻常青与哀悼。

entries.zh: 遍；一圈、周围（circuito、ambito 的对应词）
entries.en: a round, a circuit; the compass or circumference of a place
entries.notes: 官话栏 giēn 与遍（piên）音不合，疑栏位错行或转写有误，仅以汉字与西语义定夺。

entries.en: to encircle; a ring or circuit drawn round about (circuito, ambito)

entries.zh: 头箍；女子头上饰珠宝的环形头饰
entries.en: head-band; the hoop or circlet women wear on the head set with jewels
to circumcise; to cut off the foreskin (circuncidar)

entries.zh: 割玉脛皮；行割礼的完整说法（割去阳头之皮）
entries.en: to circumcise fully; to cut the skin of the glans (circuncidar, fuller form)
entries.notes: 玉脛为方言指阳头之词，与上条割皮同义而更具体，天主教传教语境记犹太与回教割礼之俗。

entries.en: ice; lump of ice (Sp. cirmiones de yelo, for trozos/panes de yelo)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Cirmiones de yelo 拼写疑有讹（或为 cirmos/tercios de yelo），然汉字与闽、官两音均为冰，义可定。

entries.en: hoar-frost and ice; frozen rime (with ice)
entries.notes: 同上，西语词头有讹；霜冰为复合词，霜 sng、冰 peng 两音互证。

entries.en: jujube, Chinese date (Ziziphus); the Spanish headword ciruela 'plum' is applied loosely to a dried fruit
entries.notes: 西语 Ciruela 本义李/西洋梅干，汉、闽、官三栏均为枣，系传教士以西语干果名套记中国果品。

entries.en: dried jujubes; preserved dates/raisins (Sp. ciruelas secas)
entries.notes: 西语栏 ciruelas para… 截断未完，据汉字枣乾与 cuā̃（乾）补足其义。

entries.zh: 外科；外科医生、外科（之术）
entries.en: surgery; surgeon, the art of the barber-surgeon (cirujano)
